correctness.rationale: Cut a uniform Dyck path at midpoint n; reversal of second half with U/D swap gives an independent pair of nonnegative prefixes of length n conditional on common height. The joint count J_n=T_n T_n^T, with T_n(a,h) counting prefixes with first ascent a. This proves PSD and same-function covariance via conditional-mean variance. Reflection gives the closed binomial formula including deterministic a=b=n boundary. Planar noncrossing paths from staggered sources (a+1,a−1) to ordered height endpoints imply total nonnegativity of every minor of T_n by LGV, then Cauchy–Binet of J_n. The selected rows a=ceil(n/2),...,n produce an upper triangular d×d submatrix with diagonal one, d=floor(n/2)+1, proving exact rank. Two-row plateau a=1,2 for n≥3 follows from first-three-step bijection; ballot row-sum ratios and top support imply strict stochastic increase thereafter, with n=2 exception. Independent exhaustive generator of all Dyck paths n=1..8 recreated boundary formula, rank and every 2×2 minor: Catalan counts 1,2,5,14,42,132,429,1430 and ranks 1,2,2,3,3,4,4,5. Finite tests are corroboration, not an all-minor proof.
